==Completed==
Fixing all of our [[Special:DoubleRedirects|redirect chains]]. Redirect chains happen when a redirect links to a redirect that links to another redirect, etc. This is not good as it takes longer to get to the destination page, it can make browsers think the site is unsafe, and is just generically annoying. The best fix for this is to just make all of the redirects link to the destination page. (E.G. if <span style="color: var(--theme-link-color)">Q</span> redirects to <span style="color: var(--theme-link-color)">W</span> which redirects to <span style="color: var(--theme-link-color)">E</span> which redirects to <span style="color: var(--theme-link-color)">A</span>, which is the destination page, we can just make <span style="color: var(--theme-link-color)">Q</span>, <span style="color: var(--theme-link-color)">W</span>, and <span style="color: var(--theme-link-color)">E</span> all link to <span style="color: var(--theme-link-color)">A</span>.) '''Note''': This has no degrading effect on redirects, articles that link to a redirect that I change the link will still link to the destination page, just in a more conventional manner.<hr>
